rationale: This is exceptional, highly authored work whose drawing-sheet system, live network diagrams and sequence-proof interaction arise directly from the business rather than from a reusable SaaS aesthetic. Its principal weakness is density: very wide views make important material small, while phone layouts create exceptionally long reading journeys, but neither issue undermines the clarity or distinctiveness of the experience.

criterionScores.note: The proposition that the site itself is an engineering drawing sheet is sustained through rules, title blocks, technical metadata, restrained colour and document-like compositions without becoming costume.
criterionScores.whyNotHigher: The system is exceptionally coherent but has a fairly narrow expressive range; several long pages rely on the same split-sheet construction and cream field.
positiveEvidence: The shared drawing-sheet language connects navigation, page furniture, diagrams, schedules, permits and footers.
Red, green, amber and black are used semantically rather than decoratively.
The refusal panel provides a controlled expressive break while remaining part of the technical-document system.

criterionScores.note: The structure and components are inseparable from HV switching work: network states, numbered operations, isolation and earthing points, risk profiles, permits, restorations and model revisions constitute the interface.
criterionScores.whyNotHigher: The evidence is a polished prototype for one fictional worked example, so the system's ability to retain this specificity across varied real networks is not demonstrated.
positiveEvidence: The same network model is rendered at successive schedule states.
The failed earth operation is explained through a visible live path across named plant.
The permit derives its isolation and earthing points from proved sequence steps.
The pilot page asks for precisely the operational material required to model and prove a customer's schedule.

criterionScores.note: Overview, proved schedule, rule set, network model and pilot each answer a distinct buyer or practitioner question, while the home page previews the deeper routes in a purposeful order.
criterionScores.whyNotHigher: Some pages remain very long, and the persistent top-level labels “Schedule,” “Proving” and “Network” require initial interpretation before their relationship is fully obvious.

criterionScores.note: Every route establishes a strong thesis, then shifts convincingly between editorial explanation, technical evidence and metadata. Critical states such as refusal, proof result and permit issue receive unmistakable emphasis.
criterionScores.whyNotHigher: At wide resolution the content becomes unusually small relative to the canvas, weakening immediacy, and long technical lists sometimes settle into an even visual cadence.

criterionScores.note: Type does substantial compositional work through authoritative headlines, compact engineering labels, monospaced references, disciplined measures and finely handled metadata.
criterionScores.whyNotHigher: Captions and metadata approach the lower edge of comfortable reading at desktop and become especially diminutive in the wide captures.

criterionScores.note: Large editorial openings, dense proof regions, warning panels, quieter explanatory sections and technical footers create deliberate changes in pressure across the scroll.
criterionScores.whyNotHigher: The wide layouts contain stretches of underused space, while the schedule and mobile overview demand very long uninterrupted journeys through similarly ruled rows.

criterionScores.note: The network drawing is not illustrative garnish: it is the central evidence, changes with the selected operation and directly demonstrates why the schedule is refused or proved.
criterionScores.whyNotHigher: The screenshots demonstrate one network topology repeatedly; broader visual handling for larger or radically different substations is not evidenced.
positiveEvidence: Step 04 and step 07 show materially different computed network states.
The failed earth is drawn closed onto a conductor that remains red.
The at-risk sequence chart, state legend, permit and restoration all extend the product argument rather than merely decorate it.
The phone preserves the diagram at legible scale through a dedicated pannable viewport.

criterionScores.note: The supplied states demonstrate unusually deliberate interaction semantics: hover, keyboard focus and selection are distinct; arrow-key schedule control updates the model; the drawing is keyboard-pannable; the readout pins; reduced motion reaches the same result; and a skip link is present.
criterionScores.whyNotHigher: The evidence is still static, so timing, tactile continuity, error recovery, touch behaviour and performance cannot be judged.
positiveEvidence: Hover fill, focus bracket and selection rule remain visibly distinct when concurrent.
Keyboard selection updates both the network drawing and state readout.
The mobile drawing exposes a focusable scroll region rather than relying on pointer gestures.
The refusal state connects the selected operation to a detailed causal readout.
Reduced-motion output is explicitly shown to preserve the identical final state.

criterionScores.note: Phone views regroup metadata, convert multi-column schedules and assurance tables into readable row systems, preserve the header CTA, and solve the irreducible network diagram with panning and a pinned readout.
criterionScores.whyNotHigher: Several pages still become extremely long, and the diagram viewport initially reveals only half the network, imposing exploration before the full topology can be understood.

criterionScores.note: The restrained engineering-document temperament communicates seriousness, traceability and refusal to bluff—an unusually precise fit for safety-critical software sold to Senior Authorised Persons.
criterionScores.whyNotHigher: The severe institutional tone leaves little warmth or human presence for commercial reassurance, and whether that balance suits actual buyers cannot be established from screenshots alone.
positiveEvidence: The visual language privileges evidence, revision identifiers and accountable records over marketing spectacle.
Warnings and proved states use restrained operational colour rather than theatrical effects.
The repeated statement that Interlock signs nothing aligns the brand with the user's existing authority structure.

criterionScores.note: The home page states the risk and method immediately, the pilot CTA is persistent, and the pilot route plainly lists inputs, outputs, pricing, term, deployment, insurance and responsibility.
criterionScores.whyNotHigher: The primary CTA wording asks users to supply a schedule before the less demanding phone-call entry point becomes visible, and proof of real adoption is intentionally absent, limiting immediate external trust evidence.

criterionScores.note: Nearly every visible choice is traceable to engineering documents or the proof workflow. There are no generic gradients, floating cards, logo walls, dashboard stand-ins, ornamental icons or vague innovation claims.
criterionScores.whyNotHigher: Some familiar editorial minimalism remains in the oversized headlines and spacious two-column essay sections, even though it is strongly justified here.
positiveEvidence: The visual system is built from drawing borders, revision fields, schedule rows and electrical-state notation.
All status colours carry operational meaning.
The central product demonstration uses real domain-shaped states and causal language rather than generic interface chrome.
The content openly distinguishes implemented rules from specified but unbuilt rules.

criterionScores.note: The signature experience is selecting step 07 and watching an earth close onto a still-red conductor while the refusal identifies the live path through the network. That moment is both visually memorable and the business proposition made concrete.
criterionScores.whyNotHigher: Most of the surrounding pages intentionally recede into the drawing-sheet system, so memorability is concentrated in the proof interaction rather than sustained through every part of the experience.
positiveEvidence: The red live route and closed green earth make the abstract back-energisation fault instantly visible.
The adjacent causal readout names the omitted operation and enumerates the live path.
The drawing, schedule and refusal behave as one explanatory object rather than separate marketing sections.

signatureMoment: Selecting step 07 closes the earth switch onto a conductor that remains visibly red, while the refusal panel names the omitted breaker operation and traces the complete back-energisation route.

comparisons.note: Both aesthetics are downstream of the product claim: Linear expresses speed and precision, while Interlock turns engineering documentation and proof into the entire visual system. Linear demonstrates a broader expressive range.

Interlock's typography is highly considered, especially in metadata and technical labels, but Linear sustains tighter legibility and hierarchy across more scales without the very small wide-screen text seen here.
Interlock has excellent density changes and sheet-like structure, but its wide layouts occasionally dissipate into large empty fields and its long schedules become rhythmically repetitive.

Interlock's five-route sequence moves coherently from claim to proof, model and purchase, with unusually candid separation of shipped and planned capabilities. Linear handles a substantially broader product story with similarly strong editing.

Interlock makes strong phone-specific decisions, especially the pannable diagram and pinned readout, but its mobile pages remain extremely long and sometimes require horizontal exploration to recover context.

The demonstrated keyboard, focus, hover, reduced-motion and state-selection work is exceptional, but static screenshots cannot establish the timing and end-to-end behavioural polish for which Linear is the benchmark.
Interlock's step-07 back-energisation proof is as describable and product-native as Linear's signature interface demonstrations, though Interlock concentrates that impact in fewer moments.

Interlock's schedule, network state, permit, restoration, model versioning and refusal logic would be actively wrong for another sector; an unusually large share of the visible experience is domain-shaped.

benchmarkGapDetail: Clearly good, and clearly below benchmark quality. The reference is meaningfully stronger on several dimensions.

evidenceCeiling.detail: Evidence covers all 5 route(s) of this artifact at 4 viewport(s). Nothing is unphotographed, so evidence caps the claim at 10.
